$comment: The source of sf-button-close's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/close (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

size.summary: Size on the ladder: as a button the box is the control ladder (1/3 24px, 1/2 32, 1 40, 2 48, 3 56; 24-52 on a phone) and the cross its step; 1/4 and 4-7 are glyph sizes only, drawn by a button at the nearest ladder step. The line is 2px at every size.

height.summary: The button's height (owner decisions C27, C35), as on sf-button and sf-button-icon: size sets the cross and the box's step, height picks the box's height from that step's tightness steps -- low, default, high, highest -- on the UI height ladder; the box stays square and the cross keeps its size. Size 1 on desktop 32/40/48/56, phone 28/36/44/52; an explicit size keeps its step in a compact region (C22), as every size does. sf-toast's close is size 1, height low: 32, compact and phone 28. Inside a containing button the element is the cross only and height does nothing. A value outside the list reads as default.

appearance.summary: How the close looks (owner decision C14). ghost, the default: a plain cross in the ink of its place, and a spot of --sf-surface-container-hover / -active under it on hover and press, shaped by radius. plain: no spot ever; the cross steps up from the ink step 64 to full, and the keyboard ring stands around the cross -- tags, a field's clear, an inline remove. media: over a photo or a video, a black circle at the ink steps 48 / 64 / 80 with a white cross, the same in both themes.

radius.summary: The shape of the ghost spot, as the icon buttons beside it: default is the rounded square of controls, rounded a circle. plain has no spot; media is always a circle.

scheme.summary: The cross's ink: the text colour, or one step quieter (it comes up to on-surface on hover). media is always white.

backdrop.summary: What the close stands on. surface, the default: a page, a card, a dialog. color: a coloured banner or bar; the cross takes the place's ink (currentColor) and the ghost spot is that ink at the state steps 8 / 12.

disabled.summary: Disables the button: no spot, the cross in the disabled ink, out of the tab order.

relations.name: icon-buttons
$comment: The box of the button: the icon button's size ladder and its focus ring.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-button-close for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.section: rename plan R0 (ui-control RENAME-PLAN-2026-11-03), naming decision 2026-11-02
rows.note: the element is sf-button-close; sf-close is a subclass defined beside it until the date

x-summary: The close button of the SIMAI Framework: a real button (focus, Enter and Space, the name «Закрыть» by default) drawing the cross with a 2px line, in three looks -- ghost, plain and media. Inside a native button it stays the decorative cross it was before 1.2.0.
x-decisions: a11y-role: button (1.2.0, owner decision C14). Standalone, the element draws a native <button type="button"> with the cross inside: focusable, Enter and Space press it, the page listens to its click. Inside a native button or an icon button (sf-button-icon kind="close", a page's own .sf-icon-button) it stays the decorative cross of 1.1.x: aria-hidden, never focusable, the containing button owns the name and the action; that use keeps working until the pages move to the button.
a11y-name: the host's aria-label, else the runtime word close («Закрыть» / «Close») in the page language.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (size 1) plus the default 1/3, the smallest 1/4 and the largest 7, and the glyph inside a native icon button.

css-variables: five public variables (glyph colour, background, glyph size, padding inline and block), read by the class sheet with the role token as fallback (§6) and listed in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json.
version 1.0.0: the interface is unchanged (size alone); nothing is renamed, so aliases.json is empty.

version 1.0.2: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.1.0: the tag is sf-button-close (naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>]); the folder, the id smart.button-close and the bundle cl-button-close follow it. sf-close stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: a subclass the Smart base defines beside the new tag, listed in the rule, in sheets as :is(sf-button-close, sf-close) (change journal tag-sf-close-to-sf-button-close, path-smart-close-to-button-close).

version 1.2.0 (owner decision C14; docs review R032, R036): sf-button-close is the close button. Settings appearance (ghost, plain, media), radius (default, rounded), scheme (on-surface, on-surface-variant), backdrop (surface, color) and disabled; the box is the icon button's ladder (1/3-3, 24-56px, 24-52 on a phone) and the cross's line is 2px at every size and width (component.close 1.1.x draws it from one picture without a viewBox). sf-button-icon kind="close" stays the old name of this button (alias map, documentary row); inside a native button the element is the decorative cross as before.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-button-close for every close or remove action: dialogs, drawers, toasts, banners (ghost), tags, a field's clear and inline remove (plain), over photos and video (media).
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not put sf-button-close inside another button for a new page: it is the button
Do not draw a bordered or filled square or circle around the cross

accessibility.focus: The native button is focusable and in the tab order; its name is aria-label, else the runtime word close («Закрыть»). Inside a containing button the cross is decorative and never focusable.
